description: Messages both implementations must accept. For dwkp and dwcp, decoding `input` and re-encoding must produce exactly `canonical`; for dwkp, framing it must produce exactly `frame_hex`. For event records, the bytes read must be the bytes re-emitted, and `expect` names the interpretation. `canonical` and `frame_hex` are computed by tests/protocol/oracle/fill_canonical.mjs, independently of both implementations.
